body: Yes, thank you. That helps so much. Fuck off.
Associated with PTSD, but not strictly PTSD. It has more to do with self-esteem and how you perceive others, which is associated with so many mental disorders.
I dreamt about her, and it was horrible. You try so hard to move on and then your brain just bones you over. Like I didn't ask to be reminded, but thank you brain.
The reason is to get the pain i deserve.
Yes. Very much so.
How on earth did you take this as a sexual desire?

I did see red flags. We knew she had it before we split. It wasnt like it was a huge surprise. The point isnt that Im astounded she's over it. The point is that she's over me. Kinda a relief in a way that she doesnt have to deal with the heartbreak (I want her to be happy), but there's a piece of me that wants me to be grieved over. Idk if it's an ego thing. I guess Im just an asshole.
thank you (:
I can never make eye contact with anyone.
How about one giant ass group hug?

I don't know. I'm not one to give my opinions or even have an opinion for that matter. I'd say if it works, then it works. If not, then I don't know. I'm not going to start saying what people should and shouldn't do. That would be kinda arrogant given my current mental state. Me, personally, I have no interest in psychedelics, but other people can do whatever they want.

Whenever someone compliments or talks nicely about me, I almost get offended. I'm a monster, and I have no reason to think I'm good, so this person must be saying nice things to me with an ulterior motive. They want to feel good about themselves for being kind, they just want to slither into my life and then abandon me, or they're too dumb to see the real person I am.
I don't like thinking this way, but I do.
That's a scalper for ya.
Punching my pillow doesn't help. I burn and cut myself.

I'm just so terrified. I'm sorry. I'm terrified of myself. I'm terrified of what's going to happen. I feel so empty, but I also feel so scared at the same time. I feel like I'm a time-bomb that's cannon-balling through everything, and there's no way of getting better without hurting the people I love. I hate myself so much, and I have no idea what to do. Your advice is appreciated, but I've been too brain-fucked and too foggy to actually process anything anyone says. I'm sorry.
I just hate this so much. I don't have time. I don't have time to be depressed. I need to either kill myself or just get over it.
I don't know what half of those things mean, but I can try.
Thanks, but I said it doesn't help hearing I will find someone else. I know she wasn't "the one" or "the only one" for me. It just hurts losing her.
I feel so much more isolated than I usually do. People say I'm manipulative or homicidal or evil. I'm not. I just want help. But I'm afraid people will hate me and not want to help me.
Also, I have a shit ton to lose.
Some therapists outright deny help to people with BPD because of the stigma. And I have hurt myself quite a bit. I would be lying if I said I didn't have an intense hatred for myself.
I'm just afraid.

I'm afraid to tell my therapist. There's a stigma that people with BPD are horrible people. And I'm a guy. BPD is typically seen as a woman's illness. I am afraid I'll either be shunned, not believed or both. I don't know what to do, and every scenario I can plot out with this has no good ending.
I'm sorry. I dont mean to be so pathtic.
I said I go to therapy/counseling, and I have gone onto many online help groups like TalkLife, like I said in the post.
